summary: EDENOR, the Argentine electricity distribution company, furnished a Form 6-K reporting the acceptance by its board of the resignation of Ms. Flavia Bevilacqua as Alternate Director, effective per the November 11, 2026 board action, citing strictly personal reasons. She had been appointed by the Class B shareholder at the April 29, 2026 Ordinary and Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting. The disclosure is a routine material-fact notice to the Comisión Nacional de Valores and BYMA, signed by CFO Germán Ranftl and Market Relations Officer Lucila Ramallo. No board seat change at the full-director level, no stake, price, premium or timeline, and no strategic, transactional or structural implications; the alternate-director vacancy is the only item to monitor, and there is no risk-arb angle.
